answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Vessel captain licence with maritime authority attestation changes that arithmetic: a captain licence number verifiable in the maritime authority register, so the trellis for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the hollow is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the whisper of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
